_about: PARKED. Wave 2 of ../m0-rich.md: the Anti-hero's 15 entries as specs Animation can pose from. Not loaded, not hashed. direction and ground are copied from moveset.antihero.m0.json. Working labels throughout; Legal screened the Legal lines: GO (docs/legal/rule-of-cool-screen.md, the wave 2 section).
shapeLanguage: blades: in flight he is one narrow line, led by a shoulder or a forearm guard; turns are banked like a blade on edge; the crouch is a coiled line with one hand down. No look depends on the tail; if the tail stays it trails as one line.

time.c: the template's approach time: distance / 2600 s, between 15 and 39 ticks; 20 at least for a heavy; beyond 2,500 u the pursuit flight, 48 to 120 ticks
time.start: ticks the start pose holds, inside the travel
time.arrive: ticks of the arrival pose before the strike's own load, inside the travel
time.standOutOfReach: plain flight to reach, 12 ticks later than a rush, then the stand entry (control-rules.md section 8)
time.retreatOutOfReach: the counter stance: the back move, then a hold of up to 45 ticks; 10 ticks of recovery if nobody comes

ends: every entry ends at the contact distance of the strike that follows it (wave 1: 32 to 58 u), on his own side, at the rival's height

brokenLeg: on the ground drop every entry whose ground is plant or only
dash stays, after the 20-tick slower take-off
what stays on the ground: dash, rising; rooted; fade
brokenArm: a skid and a coil spring put the good hand on the ground

entries.fire: bolts from the folded arm's hand every 6 ticks; a burst on arrival
entries._legal: not both arms trailed straight back, and not one fist punched ahead
entries.look: One narrow blade: a shoulder and its forearm guard lead, the other arm folded to the chest, legs together behind.

entries.when: in the air, 600 u or more away, or 2 bh or more above the rival

new: start: a kick upward off nothing, back arched
arrive: head down over the rival, the striking limb already raised

entries.sim: needs a path on the rush
entries.fire: a volley fanned downward at the top of the arc
entries.look: He climbs first, then folds at the top and comes down on the rival like a dropped blade, level with him on the last tick.

entries.when: the rival is 1.5 bh or more above him, or he is on the ground and the rival is in the air

new: arrive: under the rival, body a vertical line, the striking limb low and loaded

entries.fire: bolts straight up from one hand; a burst under the rival on arrival
entries.look: Straight up from below, the body one vertical line, open hands flat along his thighs until the last moment.

entries.when: both on the ground, 200 to 1,500 u apart

new: start: the drop onto one hip and one hand
arrive: braking on the hand and the outside foot, the other leg free

entries.sim: needs a path on the rush
entries.fire: none: his hands are on the ground
entries.look: He runs, drops and slides the last stretch on a hip and a hand, arriving under the rival's guard.

entries.when: in the air, 800 u or more away; always the ping-pong's intercept

new: start: a banked turn away from the rival, one arm leading the curve

entries.sim: needs a path on the rush
entries.fire: a volley thrown across the inside of the curve
entries._legal: flight only: he is drawn the whole way, with no vanish and no afterimage that hides him
entries.look: He leaves at an angle and curves back in, banked like a blade on edge, arriving from the side.

entries.when: from the ground or a wall, within 900 u; needs both legs

new: start: the deepest crouch, one hand on the ground, hips above the head

entries.fire: none in the spring; a point-blank burst on arrival
entries._legal: hands open and forward, or one on the ground: never clenched fists at his sides; no scream, ground-crack or rising-rubble effect on the crouch
entries.look: He sinks, holds for a beat, and uncoils flat and low at the rival's middle.

entries.fire: planted volleys from both hands in turn
entries.look: One short, flat step, the head level, the hands already where the strike starts.

new: the pivot: weight on the lead foot, the rear hip swinging round, shoulders a beat behind the hips

entries.fire: an arc thrown off the turn
entries.look: He turns on the lead foot and lets the turn become the blow.

new: the plant: a drop into the crouch on the spot, spine curled, eyes up

entries.fire: a charged shot from the crouch, one hand braced on the ground
entries._legal: hands open and forward, or one on the ground: never clenched fists at his sides; no scream, ground-crack or rising-rubble effect on the crouch
entries.look: He drops into the crouch where he stands and strikes up out of it.

entries.when: in reach; only once fight lanes land

new: the lane step: a sidestep toward or away from the camera, body turned a quarter

entries.look: A sidestep off the line, so the blow comes from beside the rival's guard.

entries.when: in reach; the only stand entry with a broken leg on the ground
entries.fire: the turret: charged shots and volleys from where he stands
entries._legal: hands low and open while he waits; no beckoning and no arms-crossed pose
entries.look: He does not move his feet at all: the blow comes out of the stance.

entries.when: in reach, or as the counter stance out of reach
entries.fire: kiting bolts while he backs away
entries.look: One step back with the weight on the rear leg, then straight back in as the rival follows.

entries.when: in reach; the only retreat entry with a broken leg on the ground
entries.fire: a point-blank burst as he comes forward
entries._legal: a lean from the hips of about 30 degrees at most, feet planted: not a backbend
entries.look: His feet stay; the head and chest slip back out of range and come forward again with the counter.

new: the hop: both knees drawn up, body leaning in toward the rival

entries.fire: a volley fired down the line he left
entries.look: A short hop back and up, so the counter comes down from a little above.

new: the drop: back and down into the crouch, under the line of the blow

entries.fire: a low arc along the ground
entries._legal: hands open and forward, or one on the ground: never clenched fists at his sides; no scream, ground-crack or rising-rubble effect on the crouch
entries.look: He gives ground downward: back into the crouch under the blow, then up through the rival's middle.
